info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Tax Administration Retrieval API provides access to financial data relevant to enterprise tax matters using specified parameters. This API is designed to empower businesses with important insights for compliance and financial planning. Developers can leverage this API to obtain specific taxation information critical for decision-making processes. Typical consumers include financial analysts and tax professionals who need to retrieve detailed financial data related to enterprise taxation.

get.summary: Retrieve the details of a specific enterprise tax administration resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific enterprise tax administration resource identified by its unique ID. It provides comprehensive data necessary for understanding the tax administration context within the finance domain.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the enterprise tax administration for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. The request must include parameters that conform to the specified schema.
